title: Hearty Portuguese Cod Stew
description: A springy, funky cod stew that pairs creamy creme fraiche with a manteca-emulsified tomato base, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp manteca in a claypot over medium heat until the fats blend.
Add smoked paprika and dried oregano, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in diced tomatoes, tomato paste, and water, bring to a gentle simmer.
Carefully lay cod fillets into the simmering liquid, ensuring they are fully covered.
Cover the pot and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily.
Remove the claypot from heat and stir in 150g creme fraiche, whisking to emulsify into a silky base.
Season with salt, black pepper, and a splash of white wine vinegar to brighten the flavor.
Distribute the stew into bowls, garnish with fresh parsley if desired, and serve hot.
